data.one_liner: Mobile in-app threat detection, runtime app self-protection, and security monitoring SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides threat detection and security monitoring features for Android and iOS mobile devices. It aims to cover RASP (Runtime App Self Protection) and application shielding aspects like root/jailbreak detection, hook detection, and bootloader checks.
use_when: You need to detect root or jailbreak attempts on mobile devices.
You want to monitor applications for reverse-engineering or hooking frameworks like Frida.
You require application shielding and threat detection features for Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are developing for web or desktop platforms only.
You do not need native application security or threat monitoring features.
strengths: Covers core RASP and application shielding features across Android and iOS.
Detects advanced threats like root/jailbreak, hooking frameworks, and UI automation.
Provides weekly security reports and threat detection insights.
weaknesses: Freemium software with a fair usage policy that imposes limitations on free usage.
Requires specific native setup and configuration steps for Android and iOS integration.
data.setup_notes: Requires following platform-specific integration guides for Android and iOS, and handling native dependencies or configuration steps.
